unlisted_practices: Visual-aware edge module for non-invasive capture of bedside monitor data to reduce manual transcription errors
Cloud-edge-end hierarchical deployment for low-latency voice-based LLM querying of structured ICU patient data

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates a human-AI synergy system combining edge computer vision for monitor reading and an LLM for voice queries in the ICU, focusing on system architecture and feasibility without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
